external_research_reinjection.source: Wong, Nouwen, Gatt (2026), When Models Decide and When They Bind: A Two-Stage Computation for Multiple-Choice Question-Answering, arXiv:2601.03914
external_research_reinjection.finding: The reported mechanism separates earlier content-winner selection from later output-symbol binding under content/symbol permutations.
external_research_reinjection.project_implication: Evaluate Xeno semantic decision correctness and episode-local symbol/codebook routing as separable axes before accepting a monolithic final-symbol score. This is method evidence, not Qwen3.5-0.8B-specific project evidence.

external_research_reinjection.source: Kim (2025), Task Schema and Binding: A Double Dissociation Study of In-Context Learning, arXiv:2512.17325
external_research_reinjection.finding: The paper reports a causal double dissociation between task-schema and binding mechanisms across multiple architectures.
external_research_reinjection.project_implication: Strengthens factorized unseen-codebook/binding diagnostics; does not establish the same mechanism in the current Xeno checkpoint.

external_research_reinjection.source: Alur et al. (2025), The Impossibility of Inverse Permutation Learning in Transformer Models, arXiv:2509.24125
external_research_reinjection.finding: For the paper's formal inverse-permutation task, decoder-only transformers face an impossibility result, while scratch-token padding admits a constructive solution.
external_research_reinjection.project_implication: Generate a high-risk diagnostic hypothesis that nonsemantic scratch/carrier slots may materially help difficult episode-local permutation binding; test separately because the theorem's task is not the Xeno task.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Instantiated typed transition supervision will generalize better than rule narration on unseen process instances and reduce policy/schema parroting.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: The 0.8B model can infer concrete state transitions from meta-rule targets without measurable loss.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.cheapest_discriminator: Matched-token pilot: meta-rule donor vs instantiated-transition donor; score only exact state-after values/refs, semantic digest and ClayCode/ABI validity on family-disjoint unseen instances.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: A factorized semantic-kernel plus episode-local binder objective/eval will outperform end-to-end-only supervision on unseen full codebook permutations.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Fully crossed end-to-end SFT already learns both stages and explicit factorization wastes capacity.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.cheapest_discriminator: Equal-budget BASE vs E2E-only vs semantic-kernel+E2E, with orbit-exact accuracy, equivariance violations, semantic stability and unseen-permutation/symbol/template holdouts.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: A small fixed budget of explicitly nonsemantic scratch/carrier slots improves hard episode-local permutation binding without encoding stable class semantics.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Scratch slots only add latency/context and become a new shortcut surface.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.cheapest_discriminator: Frozen synthetic binding benchmark with identical semantic/codebook distributions and matched token budget: zero-scratch vs fixed nonsemantic scratch slots; require unseen-permutation improvement plus no class-to-slot MI/shortcut leakage.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: A stale gate can falsely reject or mis-rank otherwise correctly measured checkpoints, so contract reconciliation must precede expanded checkpoint selection.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: The drift is bookkeeping-only and matched behavioral evaluation can safely proceed independently.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.cheapest_discriminator: Build the successor source-integrity gate and replay the same exact bound identity/loader receipts; require deterministic classification stability before spending model-evaluation budget.
